# CriticalPointControl

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The deliberate tuning of system parameters to operate near a critical point where response sensitivity is maximized. Allows topology-centric computing to exploit phase transitions for enhanced computational sensitivity and switching.
